facts.value: Copies current CPU, draw and total values every call. Each recent value is replaced when a larger sample arrives or when the old signed hold counter is negative; the counter is post-decremented only if the larger-sample test fails, then reset to 60 on replacement. With no larger sample, expiry occurs on the 62nd subsequent updater call. Accumulated maxima continue updating even when their text is disabled; fn_80392A08 clears them only on a zero-to-nonzero enable transition.
facts.rationale: Correct nested visibility, reset scope, exact countdown behavior or canonical parameter declaration.

facts.value: void fn_80392A08(int mode, int scale, int enable). Canonical names are mode, scale and enable. mode is used numerically as the graphical frame-count divisor and zero disables graphics. scale is tested as a zero/nonzero ordinary-text flag. enable is stored as an int and enables the maxima row only within the ordinary-text branch; a zero-to-nonzero transition resets maxima. Values are not validated or normalized.

facts.value: Nonzero mode emits one segmented bar and three gradients. For positive mode, the bar has one green unit, up to three yellow units beyond one, and red units beyond four. Negative mode also enters graphics with one green unit and negative divisors. scale nonzero enables current/recent timing text; accumulated maxima text is nested inside that branch and also requires enable nonzero. At most six static items are occupied; no items returns NULL, otherwise the last occupied next link is NULL.
facts.rationale: Correct nested visibility, reset scope, exact countdown behavior or canonical parameter declaration.
